notes.title: FREEZIA Bug Fix Update
notes.content: [p]Thank you for playing FREEZIA.[/p][p]FREEZIA received the following updates today:[/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed issue with the extra mode Time Attack Mode rankings.[/p][p]- Added ability to view extra mode rankings at any time[/p][p][/p][p]Due to these updates, the Time Attack Mode rankings will be rolled back to an older period, meaning that the rankings for some players recordeded between that period and now will not be displayed. [/p][p]We apologize for the inconvenience and will continue to do our best to ensure the rankings run smoothly.[/p][p]We hope you will continue to enjoy your time with FREEZIA.[/p]

notes.title: About the Time Attack Mode Ranking Glitch
notes.content: [p]Thank you for playing FREEZIA.  [/p][p] We have confirmed an issue where high scores are not being recorded correctly in the Time Attack mode after clearing the game.   [/p][p]We are currently working on a fix for this issue.   [/p][p]Once the fix is complete, we will announce it on the ‘FREEZIA’ store page news section, so please wait a little longer until the fix is applied.    [/p][p]Please note that high scores recorded before the fix may not be reflected after the fix is applied.    [/p][p]We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.    [/p][p]We appreciate your continued support of ‘FREEZIA’.  [/p]

notes.title: FREEZIA Video, Livestream, and Fan Content Guidelines
notes.content:
Introduction:
1. These guidelines are for individuals making non-commercial content which are not intended to make profit. For commercial content, please contact sassan03 at sassan.san.03@gmail.com separately. It may take some time for a reply.

2. For videos, livestreams, and fan content that follow these guidelines, there is no need to ask for permission or contact after releasing the content.

3. Even if following these guidelines, please do not perform any acts that can be misinterpreted as official or authorized by FREEZIA. Additionally, do not use any language that may mislead others into believing that the activities are official or authorized.

4. Content that seriously damage the image of FREEZIA or offend public order and morals are prohibited even if following these guidelines. Sassan03 reserves the right to prohibit publication or distribution of any content found to be in violation of this.

5. If the content is deemed to be for commercial purposes beyond the scope of an individual, or to be an extremist derivative video, livestream, or fan content that promotes particular radical political ideas, its publication and distribution may be prohibited, regardless of whether this is before or after the content has been released.

6. All characters and names depicted in FREEZIA are fictional with no relation to any real people. Additionally, depictions within FREEZIA (including inhumane depictions) are for artistic purposes and are not intended to promote any particular radical ideas or actions. Please follow these principles in the videos, livestreams, and fan content that you create.

7. FREEZIA uses some assets from asset sites. Please refrain from contacting these sites about FREEZIA.

8. Sassan03 reserves the right to update these guidelines at any time.






Please refer to A for guidelines on fan content.

Please refer to B for guidelines on videos and livestreams for release on video uploading sites.





A. Fan Content
You may create fan content (e.g., derivative works, fan activities) of Sassan03's game FREEZIA under the following conditions.


1. Please do not use copyrighted materials (e.g., sprites, logos) from FREEZIA.

2. Please do not create or release content that may be misinterpreted as an official work by Sassan03.

3. Please do not infringe on the intellectual property rights of others.

4. NSFW (R-18) fan content is allowed, but please refrain from posting such content in places where they can be viewed by viewers who are not of an appropriate age, or where they may offend others.

5. Please be aware that the creator Sassan03 may view or mention your fan content on social media.

6. Please ensure that you read the Introduction of these guidelines.



Please feel free to do the following when making fan content of FREEZIA:

- Production, release, and sale of doujinshi (e.g., fan comics, fan novels), fan videos, and merchandise created for fan activities

- Organizing events for the purpose of distributing the products of fan activities

- Distribution of products and generative of revenue at events for fan activities







B. Videos and Livestreams on Video Uploading Sites
You may upload videos and livestreams of Sassan03's game FREEZIA under the following conditions.

1. Please include the following text in the summary section when uploading videos:
FREEZIA
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3355790/FREEZIA/
©2025 Sassan03 / room6

2. Please be considerate and include spoiler warnings for core story elements.

3. Acts that seriously damage the image of the work, use of the work for explicitly sexual content, and acts that otherwise offend public order and morals are prohibited.

4. Please do not use anything that infringes or may possibly infringe on the rights of any third party (e.g., intellectual property rights).

5. Please promptly remove the video if requested to do so by Sassan03.

6. Sassan03 makes no warranty of any kind regarding the publication and distribution of videos. Sassan03 will not be held liable for any damages or disputes with third parties that may arise from the use of Sassan03's work.

7. Please ensure that you read the Introduction of these guidelines.





The following assets are available for use in video and livestreams for thumbnails. 

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OCH7zCEytbbUAUqyvlj4USaodEMuVab7?usp=drive_link

Note: These assets cannot be used for derivative works or fan activities. They are only to be used as additional assets for video creation.

notes.title: FREEZIA Has Been Released!
notes.content: [p]Greetings to all you ice-cold stars out there! The wait is finally over![/p][p]Today, August 8th, FREEZIA is finally getting released.[/p][p]Not only will you be able to live through humanity's glacial future, but, with the help of your new guide, you will be able to enjoy the challenge of a special post-game mode.[/p][p]We hope FREEZIA's cold sleep will be enough to keep you cool during this hot, hot summer.[/p][p]And now, sweet dreams![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: FREEZIA Demo Streaming Now!
notes.content: The dev is streaming demo gameplay of FREEZIA! Watch along and download the demo to play for yourself.

notes.title: The FREEZIA demo is out!
notes.content:
Greetings to all you ice-cold stars out there!

The FREEZIA demo has been released for Steam Next Fest. It includes the beginning of the game along with the main gameplay. Play the demo and enjoy the story of the artificial intelligence Freezia and humankind! Also check out the discussion board for threads to share your thoughts on the demo and any bugs you encounter.

We plan to release the full version of FREEZIA in summer of 2025. Add the game to your wishlist while you wait! For now, good night, and sweet dreams!
